rolling_summary:
- Film completed/shipped; public version honors critical participant agency: Tōru's segment voiced and penned by him only; Rera’s story nearly intact; historical context implied, not exposéd.
- Reyes adapted: resisted at first but ultimately internalized lessons about narrative agency/mechanism, even if he never directly admitted it.
- Key facts: Genzō’s interview and dialect subtitled per his wishes; farm tools and family history made it in; small field knife (for Jakobus) briefly shown on-screen, still at forge, unclaimed.
- Characters physically dispersed: Yael in Lisbon, Naila home, Sandi traveling, Frik returned to farm, Mira focused on caption review; crew now communicating online only.
- Sayaka retained as historian/commentator, careful not to expose family ties with Tōru; privacy/agency respected.
- Festival interest in ensemble after film release; Rera contacted by community members regarding her refusal to be reduced to a number.
- Jakobus still absent physically and narratively: no tattoo, no knife, no Lexus movement; knife remains with Genzō.
